answer: The summit counter is kept in ivory and zenith makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 116 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
